title: Fix slash command confirmation creating two undo entries

commits.message:
feat(core): add EditorAPI.transact() for atomic multi-mutation undo

- New EditorAPI.transact(fn) method batches multiple mutations into
  one CM6 dispatch → exactly one undo entry.
- Intercepts view.dispatch during callback to collect TransactionSpecs.
- Throws 'Nested transactions are not supported' on nested calls.
- On callback throw, discards all collected specs and restores dispatch.
- Computation: replays all {from,to,insert} changes against original doc
  string buffer, emits single full-document replacement.
- No modification to existing EditorAPI methods.
- All 537 existing tests still pass.

fix(slash): make slash command confirmation a single undo step

Introduce a small EditorAPI.transact() helper to group multiple editor mutations into one undoable operation. Slash command confirmation now uses this helper so that deleting the trigger text and executing the command produce only one undo entry.
